name: Java 25 + Spring Boot + Angular 20 + Artemis
postCreateCommand: npm install -g @angular/cli@20 && curl -fsSL https://archive.apache.org/dist/artemis/artemis/2.57.0/apache-artemis-2.57.0-bin.tar.gz -o /tmp/artemis.tar.gz && sudo mkdir -p /opt/artemis && sudo tar -xzf /tmp/artemis.tar.gz -C /opt/artemis --strip-components=1 && rm /tmp/artemis.tar.gz && /opt/artemis/bin/artemis create ~/artemis-broker --user admin --password admin --require-login --http-host 0.0.0.0 --relax-jolokia && sed -i 's|<allow-origin>\*://0.0.0.0\*</allow-origin>|<allow-origin>*://*.app.github.dev*</allow-origin>|g' ~/artemis-broker/etc/jolokia-access.xml
